title: Latinos Are the Only True Swing Vote in the U.S. – But Can Dems Win Them Over in 2026?
author: John Harwood
content:
A lot of the same Latino voters who helped elect Donald Trump in 2024 are done
with him, but they're not necessarily running over to the Democrats. Why?

**" Both parties are not grasping what is happening with the largest, fastest
growing segment of the electorate, that is also the only true swing vote in
America," **says Latino Republican political consultant **Mike Madrid.**

[ Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Spoiler: it has to do more with gas prices than ICE raids. Madrid tells
**Zeteo 's John Harwood **that neither party recognizes that the economy is
overwhelmingly a bigger factor than immigration-related issues for Latino
voters. And it's having an impact in the midterms.

**" Latinos, who are the least racially polarized and the most likely to
identify as politically independent, rejecting both parties," **Madrid says,
**" are changing the way politics works because they're more than happy to
vote with their feet and leave either party at either time."**
